name: Matt Pugmire
career_summary: Senior engineering and transformation leader, most notably as Director of the Cloud Innovation Center, which he built from zero to 150+ practitioners across 15+ Fortune 500 clients. His background spans platform engineering, agile transformation, financial services technology, and AI-assisted development.

education.note: Master's degree in Information Technology satisfies requirements for 'Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field': IT is a recognized CS-related discipline and a Master's exceeds a Bachelor's requirement.
Included a year abroad at Université Paul Valéry, Montpellier, France, through an exchange program with the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (issued 2020, expired 2023)
Oracle 8i DBA exams passed (OCP track): SQL and PL/SQL, Architecture and Administration, Backup and Recovery (2002)
